temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, unlike her normally engaging self. When Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and some personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging; Carolyn has no specific knowledge of any current personal or work struggles affecting Marilyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn now believes Marilyn's quietness is explained by being overwhelmed by work and personal issues rather than by disinterest or a problem between them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under significant stress and may need support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and let Marilyn know Carolyn is available to listen if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a subsequent interaction, which confuses and slightly hurts Carolyn. When Carolyn apologizes for possibly overstepping and shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed and had seemed to appreciate Carolyn's initial concern, so the curt response is unexpected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn initially wonders whether she overstepped or whether Marilyn is upset with her, but Marilyn's response clarifies that the curtness was due to a hard week and not a rejection of Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn; she is struggling but appreciates Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then relieved, reassured, and sympathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear the misunderstanding and continue showing support while building trust with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend get-together, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks Carolyn, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn appreciates her support and that their connection may be improving, but she is not yet certain Marilyn wants a closer friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's positive response and acceptance of the invitation confirm that she is open to socializing and to strengthening their bond.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in a friendship/connection outside work and is willing to join Carolyn's gathering.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship by including Marilyn in the gathering and continuing to build the relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn have been building a warmer personal connection, so she expects that warmth to carry into their work relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn becomes disappointed and uncertain because Marilyn seems distant at work, but Marilyn's response suggests the distance may be unintentional and that Marilyn is willing to improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work distance may not be personal rejection; it can be addressed, and Marilyn is open to clarifying and improving their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and concerned initially; cautiously reassured and hopeful after Marilyn's response.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address their work dynamic directly and work toward clearer professional expectations and better collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and now understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. When Carolyn proposes teaming up for the new project proposal, Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they talked, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have begun resolving the work-distance issue and have reached a better mutual understanding, but she wants to confirm it through a collaborative project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms Carolyn's belief that they understand each other better and can work well together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn have a clearer mutual understanding and a positive, collaborative partnership.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
